seo.title: Careers at StarOrigin | Join our recruitment team
seo.description: Work at StarOrigin: recruiter and HR roles in Nagpur and Hyderabad with incentives, learning and global exposure across India, the UAE and the US.

hero.title: Do work that
hero.lead: Join the StarOrigin team. Help companies find great people and help people find work they're proud of, across India, the UAE and the US.

heroNote.text: Looking for a job with one of our clients?

heading.title: Grow with
heading.lead: The benefits below are illustrative until confirmed by HR.

items.title: Performance incentives
items.text: Monthly incentives linked to placements and client satisfaction.

items.title: Learning budget
items.text: Training in sourcing, assessment and HR certifications.

items.title: Global exposure
items.text: Work on mandates for clients in India, the Middle East and the US.

items.title: Health cover
items.text: Medical insurance for you and your family.

items.title: Mentorship
items.text: Learn directly from practice heads and senior HR managers.

items.title: Clear growth path
items.text: Defined steps from recruiter to team lead and practice head.

heading.title: How we
heading.lead: The same values we bring to clients shape our own team.

items.title: Results first.
items.text: We judge success by people placed and clients served.

items.title: Straight talk.
items.text: Direct, honest feedback, inside the team and out.

items.title: Fleet-footed.
items.text: We move quickly and close every loop.

items.title: Trust and loyalty.
items.text: Relationships that last beyond a single placement.

items.title: A personal touch.
items.text: Technology supports us; people make the calls.

heading.title: Join
heading.lead: Internal openings at StarOrigin. Roles shown are examples until live positions are published.

roles.footText: Don't see your role? Apply anyway and tell us what you'd bring.

heading.title: What to
heading.lead: A simple, respectful process. Timelines are indicative.

items.title: Apply
items.text: Send the form below with your details and LinkedIn profile.

items.title: Intro call
items.text: A short conversation with our HR team about your experience and goals.

items.title: Interviews
items.text: Meet the hiring manager and a practice head; some roles include a short task.

items.title: Offer
items.text: A clear offer and a planned first week with your new team.

heading.title: Apply to
heading.lead: We read every application and reply to all shortlisted candidates.

apply.successText: Thank you for applying. Our HR team will review your details and get in touch if there's a match.
